''See also: [[Bloodforged Iron body Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Bloodforged [[Iron body]] is a specialized type of [[Iron]]-realm physical transformation. While it possesses significant regenerative capabilities, its primary function is to provide resistance against toxins, diseases, and corrosive substances. This makes it particularly effective for surviving environments containing venom or [[acidic madra]]. A major drawback of this body type is its extreme consumption of [[madra]]. It functions by siphoning energy directly from the user's core to fuel rapid healing and physical restoration. This process can be so aggressive that it leaves the user physically depleted, limp, or powerless once their reserves are exhausted. In certain circumstances, such as when used alongside destructive techniques like [[Blackflame]], the body may struggle to keep pace with the damage being dealt to the user's flesh. However, when supplemented by specialized items like the [[Iron Heart]], its efficiency and regenerative power can be significantly enhanced.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|[[Lindon]] possesses a Bloodforged [[Iron body]], a specialized physical state designed to resist corrosive breakdown by using [[madra]] from the core to fuel recovery and heal fatigue. While [[Eithan]] believed this body was necessary for [[Lindon]] to manage the [[Path of Black Flame|Blackflame Path]], it functions by draining [[madra]] to heal him and leeches from his core whenever he is wounded. This process causes the body to burn through [[madra]] quickly, making it difficult to sustain and unable to keep up with massive injuries like a spear thick as his wrist. Despite these high costs, the body allowed [[Lindon]] to ignore the pain of a silver arrow piercing his thigh and prevented venom from spreading through his veins.}}
